events.summary: Changelog entry (posted Oct 12, 2026): redesigned Clay home page with quick access to Workflows and chat, Audiences sources & exports view (export Audiences data via Workflows), and more accurate Clay Ads match-rate reporting aligned with each ad platform.
events.headline: Product Roundup Week of October 5, 2026

events.summary: At its annual Sculpt conference in San Francisco (2,000 attendees from 30 countries), Clay introduced a new agentic way to build in Clay — an agent that plans, runs and improves GTM plays against a Knowledge Hub record of your ICP — previewed Clay Workflows (visual play canvas, in beta for all users, launching this fall) and launched the Inbound SDR Agent; the agentic product is available to Sculpt attendees immediately with broader early-access rollout in coming weeks.
events.headline: Sculpt 2026: Clay unveils agent-led self-learning revenue engine, Clay Workflows beta, and Inbound SDR Agent

events.summary: Changelog entry (posted Oct 5, 2026): Workflow Budgets to cap credit spend per workflow, bulk re-run for Workflows, trusted domain access (one-click workspace joins for company-email teammates), Clay Ads in the CLI/coding agents, and a redesigned Audiences record details view.
events.headline: Product Roundup Week of September 28, 2026

events.summary: Clay launched a marketplace (marketplace.clay.com) where users can find GTM skills built by the Clay community, free to install and ready to run in coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.
events.headline: The Clay Skills Marketplace is open

events.summary: Changelog entry (posted Sep 29, 2026): Clay added 24 new and upgraded data integrations covering EMEA and APAC coverage, buying signals, new industries, enrichment, dialers, CRMs, and warehouses (also announced on the blog as 'New and updated integrations in Clay').
events.headline: Integrations Roundup: 24 new and upgraded providers

events.summary: Changelog entry (posted Sep 28, 2026): Clay Ads company-list sync to LinkedIn with pause/edit/audit of recurring ad syncs, IP Access Restrictions to control which IPs workspace members can reach Clay from, clickable connection usage traces, and ~1-second workspace creation.
events.headline: Product Roundup Week of September 21, 2026
